Resemble Ai - AI Voice Generation and Cloning Studio for Windows 10/11

Resemble Ai is a desktop studio for generating realistic synthetic speech, cloning voices from short samples, and editing audio with AI-driven tools. It is built for podcasters, game developers, video creators, and product teams who need consistent, controllable voice output without leaving Windows. This page covers what the app does, what you need to run it, and how to get productive quickly.

        

## Overview Resemble Ai turns text into natural-sounding speech and lets you build custom voices from recorded samples. You paste or import a script, pick a voice, adjust pacing and emphasis, then render a finished WAV or MP3. Beyond straight text-to-speech, the app handles voice cloning from reference audio, batch rendering of long scripts, and quick cleanup passes on existing recordings, so a single session can take you from raw script to publish-ready narration. The people who get the most out of it are podcast and audiobook producers, indie game teams building dialogue banks, e-learning authors localizing course material, and marketing teams producing ad reads at volume. candidates.readme_excerpt:
Mondly Desktop - Language Learning Suite for Windows 10/11

Mondly Desktop brings structured language lessons, conversation practice, and vocabulary drills to a native Windows application. It is built for learners who want a focused study space on their PC instead of juggling browser tabs. This page covers what the app does, how to set it up, and how to get the most out of it.

        

## Overview Mondly Desktop is a Windows application for learning a new language through short, guided lessons. You work through daily sessions that combine vocabulary building, listening comprehension, sentence construction, and pronunciation practice, with progress tracked across every language you study. The app keeps your streak, daily goals, and review queue in one place so you always know what to do next. It fits learners who prefer a dedicated desktop workspace over a phone screen: students preparing for travel or exams, professionals picking up a second language for work, and anyone who wants a repeatable daily routine without notifications pulling them away. On Windows 10/11 it runs natively, remembers your session between launches, and lets you keep lessons open in a window beside notes, a browser, or a call. ## Requirements | Spec | Minimum | Recommended | |------|---------|-------------| | OS | Windows 10 (64-bit, version 1903 or later) | Windows 11 (64-bit, current release) | | CPU

candidates.description: VietNote ASR – Nhận dạng giọng nói tiếng Việt pha tiếng Anh (Vietnamese speech recognition, speech-to-text), streaming trên CPU. Zipformer 78M, ITN, dấu câu, fine-tune.
candidates.readme_excerpt:
# VietNote ASR

[English](README.en.md) | **Tiếng Việt**

**Nhận dạng giọng nói tiếng Việt pha tiếng Anh, chạy trực tiếp (streaming) trên CPU.**

Model: **[VietNote-Zipformer-78M-Streaming](https://huggingface.co/Kaisye/VietNote-Zipformer-78M-Streaming)**, Zipformer transducer 78M tham số.

[![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/demo-asr.vietnote.vn-0f6e56)](https://asr.vietnote.vn)
[![Models](https://img.shields.io/badge/%F0%9F%A4%97%20models-Hugging%20Face-yellow)](https://huggingface.co/Kaisye/VietNote-Zipformer-78M-Streaming)
[![Code: Apache-2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/code-Apache--2.0-blue)](LICENSE) [![Weights: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/weights-CC%20BY--NC--SA%204.0-lightgrey)](LICENSE-MODEL)

Thử ngay trên trình duyệt: **https://asr.vietnote.vn** (nói vào micro, đọc kịch bản có sẵn, hoặc nghe đoạn mẫu).

- **Streaming:** chữ hiện ra trong lúc bạn nói, mỗi bước 640 ms âm thanh.
- **Tiếng Việt pha tiếng Anh (code-switching):** nhận đúng khoảng **75% từ tiếng Anh** trong câu nói pha, gấp 2–15 lần
  các model tiếng Việt mã nguồn mở khác mà chúng tôi đã thử, gần bằng API thương mại Soniox (78%).
- **Văn bản hoàn chỉnh:** số viết bằng chữ số (1,5 tỷ · 250.000 · 15/12 · 0912 345 678 · tỷ số 2-1), dấu câu, viết hoa,
  tên thương hiệu đúng chính tả; hiểu cả khi người nói vấp hoặc sửa giữa chừng ("ba… à không, bốn triệu" → 4 triệu).
- **Nhẹ, chạy trên CPU:** 83 MB (int8), nhanh gấp khoảng **27 lần thời gian thực trên 1 lõi CPU**, không cần GPU; chạy bằng [sherpa-onnx](https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx)
  trên Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, iOS, Raspberry Pi.
- **Fine-tune được** trên dữ liệu của bạn: checkpoint PyTorch và recipe [icefall](https://github.com/k2-fsa/icefall)
  đi kèm, xem [docs/FINETUNE.md](docs/FINETUNE.md).

## Kết quả

Tỷ lệ âm tiết sai (SyER, %, càng thấp càng tốt). Tất cả hệ thống được chấm lại trên cùng máy, cùng bộ chuẩn hóa văn bản.
Chi tiết, cách đo và lưu ý: [docs/BENCHMARK.md](docs/BENCHMARK.md).

## Pedágio O Garimpo é grátis para sempre. O pedágio é outro, e não custa nada: 1. Seguir o **[@mongarde_](https://x.com/mongarde_)** no X. 2. Cadastrar o seu projeto no ranking do **[mamaevireidev.com.br](https://mamaevireidev.com.br)**. 3. Sistema de prospecção completo, aberto e grátis. Você baixa, sobe onde quiser (seu computador, uma VPS, a Vercel) e liga as suas próprias contas: - **Rastro** — acha negócios no Google Maps com um navegador de verdade. - **Esteira** — cada negócio anda sozinho: encontrado → prévia pronta → contatado → respondeu → fechado. - **Prévias** — importe **qualquer página HTML** e ela vira modelo. Bloqueia o envio. - **Skills dos agentes** — os manuais (SKILL.md) que o seu agente lê. Já vem com as 8 skills do [skill-prospeccao](https://github.com/matheusmongarde/skill-prospeccao) e importa qualquer repositório do GitHub. - **Cobranças** — link de pagamento por Mercado Pago, Stripe, Asaas ou Pix direto (QR com a sua chave). 🐉 Automate Browser-based workflows using LLMs and Computer Vision 🐉

[Skyvern](https://www.skyvern.com) automates browser-based workflows using LLMs and computer vision. It provides a Playwright-compatible SDK that adds AI functionality on top of playwright, as well as a no-code workflow builder to help both technical and non-technical users automate manual workflows on any website, replacing brittle or unreliable automation solutions.

Traditional approaches to browser automations required writing custom scripts for websites, often relying on DOM parsing and XPath-based interactions which would break whenever the website layouts changed. Instead of only relying on code-defined XPath interactions, Skyvern relies on Vision LLMs to learn and interact with the websites. # How it works Skyvern was inspired by the Task-Driven autonomous agent design popularized by [BabyAGI](https://github.com/yoheinakajima/babyagi) and [AutoGPT](https://github.com/Significant-Gravitas/Auto

candidates.readme_excerpt: # Modern Web Guidance (Source) This repo is the source repository for [GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance) and includes the code and documentation for authoring, calibrating, and evaluating its contents. Claude Desktop - AI Assistant Application for Windows 10/11

Claude Desktop brings Anthropic's AI assistant to your Windows desktop as a native application. Chat with Claude, attach files, and work through complex tasks without switching to a browser tab. This page covers what the app does, how to set it up, and what to expect day to day.

It gives you a dedicated window for conversations that persist across sessions, drag-and-drop file attachments for documents, spreadsheets, code, and images, and quick access to extended thinking modes for harder problems. You can draft a report, paste in a screenshot to analyze, or walk through a debugging session with full file context, all inside one application that stays out of your browser's tab clutter. It fits knowledge workers, developers, writers, and analysts who use Claude as part of a daily workflow rather than a one-off lookup. On Windows 10/11 it integrates with the system tray, respects Windows notification settings, supports native window snapping, and can be pinned to the taskbar for one-click access. You write test steps in plain language; Hercules runs them in a real Chromium browser on your machine and tells you whether each step passed, with screenshots and evidence for every step. Language models read the steps and decide what to click; code carries out the actions and checks the results. It is for developers and testers who want end-to-end tests without writing selectors, and for coding agents that need to check the change they just made in a real browser. ## Get started in one line ```bash uvx testzeus-hercules ``` It asks before each change: it installs the `hercules` command, sets up the browsers you want (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, Chrome, Edge), then walks you through choosing a model (a server on your machine, OpenRouter, or any OpenAI-compatible URL and key) and connecting your coding agents, so the tester UI opens ready to run. No uv? Use `pipx run testzeus-hercules`, or [install uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/) first.
